retrievalProfile.description: A symmetrical profile-to-profile confrontation between two versions of the same subject against a stark black void.
triggerTerms: two men facing each other in profile

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, square-format composition featuring two male figures in profile facing one another. The figure on the left is heavily tattooed and shirtless, wearing a thick silver chain, while the figure on the right wears a white ribbed tank top. The background is a flat, textured black, creating a sense of psychological tension and duality.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between tattooed skin and plain white fabric
Central vertical void separating the two figures
High-key lighting on subjects against a low-key background
coreInvariants: Strict profile orientation for both subjects
Pure black background with minimal texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures positioned at the left and right thirds, facing inward, scaled from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The negative space between the two faces at the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye moves from the left figure's profile to the right figure's profile, bouncing across the central gap.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black negative space surrounding and separating the subjects.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and silver metallic highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Desaturated overall with high value contrast between the subjects and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Monochromatic black and white with natural skin tones

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photograph of two men in profile facing each other against a solid black background. The man on the left should be shirtless with intricate tattoos on his neck and torso, wearing a heavy silver chain. The man on the right should wear a white ribbed tank top. Lighting should be harsh from the sides to emphasize muscle definition and profile silhouettes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small rectangular white box in the top left corner. Inside the box, place three lines of condensed black sans-serif text, separated by thin horizontal lines, mimicking a standard advisory label.

verificationChecks: Are the subjects in strict profile?
Is the text box positioned in the top left corner?
Is there a clear visual distinction between the two figures' attire?

mustAchieve: Deep, clean blacks in the background

postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical symmetry in the profile alignment.
Ensure the black background is free of distracting artifacts.
Verify the white tank top has visible ribbing texture.
Confirm the text box is legible and correctly aligned.
